hunk_reviews.judgment: The complete one-file one-hunk tree test change is a coverage contraction, not merely a deflake. It removes the default200ms debounce registration under both declared itemParameters contexts (Observable children and array children), and removes the custom300ms near-boundary assertion while widening inter-key waits1/1 to50/50 and the final wait to1.5 times the configured interval. Static registrations53 to52 pair52 retained cases;51 callbacks are unchanged and one is individually recorded with three assertions reduced to two. There is no owned legacy-tree TypeScript family: only the historical tree Sass modules are owned. Decline this private CDK test contraction; retain owned select typeahead default/custom interval and blur observations without claiming they execute or replace TreeKeyManager coverage. Current public CDK accessibility remains a reachable peer dependency; no CDK fork, invented legacy tree fixture, upstream-test absence waiver or inherited behavior pass. Actual artifact/native and supported-floor gates remain open.
